text:
Speaking of, go use my bots. They're amazing. You can add them to your Grok bot and use them for free:

Res - checks hourly for booked out restaurants and books them for you whenever something opens up

https://x.ai/bot/v5OIJ6Q7oIdUwTrRh-kfL

Claims - enter information that you're comfortable with sharing, and Grokbot will search it up in public databases to see if you're able to claim any money from lawsuits

https://x.ai/bot/4c6rlyshWwOpTN_d9HNhm

Content Creator - bot that combs through Reddit, Twitter, and other news channels to find the newest tech news, gives you a gist of it, and then a quite logical talking point so you can create content around it 

https://x.ai/bot/bjsbaj_a2ds2pQY1YiXqE

Bills - share as much information as you're comfortable with giving to this bot about your insurance, electricity, health insurance, etc. It'll go out and do shopping for you to see if there are any other competitors that can offer the same stuff but for less money. 

https://x.ai/bot/UMPD1TkUPvuo9KKuniH2w
